We haven\'t met this exact TV before. The steps are usually the same.
On the TV, open Settings (the gear, top right), then Device Preferences > About. Press OK on \"Build\" seven times until the TV says \"You are now a developer\".
Go back one screen. Open Developer options and switch on USB debugging. If the TV also shows \"Network debugging\" or \"ADB debugging\", switch that on too.
Leave the TV on this screen. Your phone will connect on its own.
On a Shield, \"Network debugging\" is the one that matters.
On the TV, open Settings, then System > About. Press OK on \"Android TV OS build\" seven times until the TV says \"You are now a developer\".
Go back one screen. Open System > Developer options and switch on USB debugging, then also Wireless debugging.
Leave the TV on this screen. Your phone will connect on its own.
On the TV, open Settings > My Fire TV > About. Select the device name seven times until the TV says \"You are now a developer\".
Go back one screen. Open Developer options and switch on ADB debugging.
Leave the TV on this screen. Your phone will connect on its own.
On the TV, open Settings > About > 本机信息, then press Up, Down, Left, Right on the remote.
A small \"ADB\" window appears with an address. Leave it open.
Leave the TV on this screen. Your phone will connect on its own.
On Google TV: System > About, then press OK on \"Android TV OS build\" seven times.
On Google TV, also switch on Wireless debugging.
On the TV, open Settings (the gear, top right), then Device Preferences > About. Press OK on \"Build\" seven times until the TV says \"You are now a developer\".
Go back one screen. Open Developer options and switch on USB debugging. If the TV also shows \"Network debugging\" or \"ADB debugging\", switch that on too.
Leave the TV on this screen. Your phone will connect on its own.

This TV needs a pairing code
This version can\'t type pairing codes yet; the next one will. If you have a computer, pair once with adb and run adb tcpip 5555, then come back; the phone takes it from there.
Show me the computer steps
Pair once from a computer
On the TV, open Developer options > Wireless debugging > Pair device with pairing code. Then run these three commands on the computer, one at a time.
adb pair ADDRESS:PAIR_PORT
adb connect ADDRESS:CONNECT_PORT
adb -s ADDRESS:CONNECT_PORT tcpip 5555

Use the address, ports and six-digit code the TV shows. When the last command has run, come back to this app. After the TV restarts, run the last two commands again with the port the TV shows then; there is no need to pair again.

Make sure the TV is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as this phone. TVs can take a minute to show up after they wake.

Help
Why a TV may not show up
Guest Wi-Fi, or a router that keeps devices apart. Ask the router for \"AP isolation\" or \"client isolation\" and switch it off.
The TV is on Ethernet while the phone is on Wi-Fi. That is fine on most routers, but some keep the two apart. Typing the TV\'s address gets around it.
A mesh system with a separate guest network. Join the phone to the main network.
Phone and TV are on different networks
The TV was last seen on a different network. Join the same Wi-Fi as the TV and we\'ll carry on.
